title: AGENTS.md in PowerShell
description: The Windows version of the same file: Set-Content writes AGENTS.md from a here-string with the identical instructions.

steps.description: This is the Windows, PowerShell version of `AGENTS.md`. It writes the same file with the same instructions.
`Set-Content -Path AGENTS.md -Encoding utf8` writes the file, taking its value from the here-string that starts at `@'`.
The content matches the shell version: the `cs357-work` heading, the one-line description, and the four bullets covering the model server, Python dependencies, error handling, and docstrings.

steps.question: The page says the instructions key names additional files to load alongside AGENTS.md, and it accepts what?
